rule: During the frozen educational phase, failures may repair the EXPERIMENT but may not expand Torin's cognitive implementation.
may_be_repaired: an exam that leaks an answer
a harness that bypasses the production ingress
a metric that cannot report failure
a database or process state that does not reset
may_not_be_repaired: Torin cannot parse a legitimate held-out construction
why: Repairing a cognitive capability mid-experiment destroys the distinction between 'Torin learned' and 'we upgraded Torin while teaching it'. A capability Torin cannot acquire through education IS the result.
why_refrozen: Version-space minimality was set inclusion, not theta-subsumption, so alpha-variant supersets survived as separate hypotheses: one correct rule came back as 22 candidates and induction could never settle. Rule IDENTITY was already renaming-invariant; subsumption had not been. Still before any Stage 2 instruction.

change.what: _minimal_hypotheses uses theta-subsumption via the canonical unifier
change.effect: 22 candidates -> 1; genuinely distinct hypotheses still report MULTIPLE_HYPOTHESES
change.unlocked: program construction end to end, model-free: two operators learned from demonstration, composed by the planner into MEAN_OF -> COUNT_EXCEEDING, and that same plan run unchanged on 3 held-out inputs -> 3/3 correct, 0 model calls
